flags.message: The frozen distribution_count of 1 reflects the May 19, 2026 distribution (Conference of 6/4/2026), which belongs to the case's miscellaneous-docket motion phase (linked 25M81) and predates the petition's August 6, 2026 docketing as 26-173 — the docket's proceedings list carries the pre-docketing entries with out-of-order dates (petition entry dated Mar 19, distribution May 19, docketed Aug 6). The relist-increment claim is stated from the frozen count of 1 as required, but the petition proper has not yet been distributed, so the increment's baseline state conflates the motion's conference with the petition's.
